purpose: Current-cycle reference lifecycle and trailing-observation delay diagnosis, NOT grid phase or arc separation
phase_semantics: Fundamental-origin segments use estimated positive-sine current phase; morphology-origin segments use a positive template maximum fixed at initialization. Synthetic morphology error may subtract one initialization offset only, never per segment/test interval. Reference is timestamped at the last observed sample, not the future block boundary.
limitations: Existing symmetric-FIR caches are offline; overlapping windows are not independent repetitions. Reference resets permit local cycles, not global origin continuity. No raw HF processing or external spending.
origin_rule: Frozen morphology origin never silently becomes fundamental. Estimate a frozen fundamental-minus-template offset using 5 consecutive trustworthy HIGHER-HARMONIC template/fundamental observations; missing bridge requires explicit epoch reset. Reset breaks comparability and output cycles; never refit synthetic origin using truth.
template_rule: Bootstrap candidates are tentative; once initialized template is frozen. No continuous template learning. No template-only rebootstrap after an established origin fails.
dynamic_rule: Fit signed phase shifts separately within 3 past cycles at their center times; a bounded coherent line gives endpoint observation and observed frequency. Reject dynamic validity on incoherence; never infer that this is a calibrated true-error bound.
evaluation: Replay retained source arrays and v1 output tables without rerunning old baselines. New generator controls are diagnostic and data-informed; all failures and regressions remain. Only one fixed candidate and recovery-only ablation, no hyperparameter sweep.
